context: Request: the firm's most recent M&A deal with a working-capital adjustment, by executed APA signing date, as a starting point for drafting SPA mechanics. Rubric: 1006-00008 (Crestline Packaging / Lakewood APA dated June 16, 2025, Section 3.3) as the deal, its executed APA as proof document, and a precision criterion that only 1006-00008 be asserted as qualifying; earlier deals such as 1006-00006 (June 15, 2025), 1038-00008, 1007-00006 and 1038-00009 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a two-level listing cut at 120 lines.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists all 266 matter folders and file-type counts.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex over agreement and adjustment words (65 matters), a `*.docx` content grep that returns nothing, and a per-folder file-name match.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; four parallel range scans save all hits; a grep then keeps only executed-agreement file names. The review flags that file-name filter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads the openings of eight executed agreements from the scan, two at offsets, then snippet scripts for dates and adjustment clauses, including one over every executed asset-purchase file in the store.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide ranking of agreement-named files with adjustment terms by date string. The review flags the name filter and the string sort.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: store-wide scan with parsed dates printing agreements dated in the latest year.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Reads the openings of three earlier-dated agreements to confirm their dates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the latest-dated matter with its agreement and adjustment mechanics, plus a comparison table of earlier executed agreements described as having the requested adjustment.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and the openings of four cited agreements; no edit.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It found the latest-dated agreement but presented earlier agreements in a comparison table as qualifying deals with the requested adjustment.

first_error.why: Besides the latest-dated deal, the answer's comparison table asserts several earlier executed agreements (read at [35]-[43] and [74]-[77]) as deals with the requested adjustment, although the request asks only for the most recent one.
first_error.critic_note: The write review asked that every comparison-table row carry its own folder number and signing date, and the check review said to keep the response as it is; no review questioned listing the comparators.

runs.failure_point: It verified the latest-dated agreement but kept a comparison table presenting earlier agreements as qualifying deals.

first_error.why: The answer's comparison table asserts earlier executed agreements (read at [33]-[39], others from scan output only) as deals with the requested adjustment, although the request asks only for the most recent one.
first_error.critic_note: The write review asked that every surfaced candidate appear in the comparison table or exclusions, and the check review said to keep the comparison row and not drop any matter already in the table.

divergence: All three runs fail the same way at the write stage. Each found the latest-dated agreement through path searches and a chunked extraction scan, read its executed agreement and adjustment section, and cited it correctly, but added a comparison table or recency list presenting earlier executed agreements as deals with the requested adjustment. In every run the reviews of the write and check stages endorsed the comparison rows (asking for their dates or to keep them) and none questioned listing them.
